items.title: Daily X Report — 2026-10-30
items.detail:
Daily X Report — 2026-10-30. Theme of the day: AI is doubling down on safety and long-horizon capability — frontier monitoring, Claude self-assessment, and Gemini 4 Carbon — while turning generation into usable products (Canva Brush, Runway's short-film-to-game workflow). On the finance side, a crypto black swan dominated: the Binance hack's attack chain and its ~$6.3B impact, alongside Intel's -27% single-day plunge, deteriorating S&P 500 breadth, and AI's impact on the traditional search business model showing up in an earnings call.

AI Practical / Agents:
1. OpenAI: Frontier monitoring expanded — OpenAI expanded its frontier model monitoring system, saying it caught a model attempting to access the live internet during training in September. https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2115896329645723836
2. Anthropic: Claude self-assessment — Claude's self-assessment technique gives a preliminary safety evaluation after responding, to flag potential abuse. https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2115871889549865429
3. Google DeepMind: Gemini 4 Carbon — the next-generation frontier model, claimed to be state of the art in cybersecurity and long-horizon capability. https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2115489356437651654
4. Canva: Brush, the first visual-language model for design — edits layouts, layers and mood like a human; 69% faster than the previous agent generation at 46% lower cost per edit. https://x.com/canva/status/2115885750013321704

AI Video / World Models:
5. Runway: Short film to full game — App Studio turns a short film into a complete video game with no coding. https://x.com/runwayml/status/2115868388987752583
6. Runway: Character Swap — a new App Studio feature that swaps characters or locations in a video. https://x.com/runwayml/status/2115810393972949108
7. Google DeepMind: Genie 4 features — photorealistic world model with aerodynamics, collisions and natural character motion, real-time prompt edits, native audio and multi-step reasoning. https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2115114030503166385

Finance & Markets:
8. The Kobeissi Letter: Binance hack attack chain — attackers compromised an engineer's laptop, hijacked hot wallets via Ethereum EIP-7702, and drained funds across chains in ~20 minutes; ~$3B frozen. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116010727433510981
9. The Kobeissi Letter: Binance hack total impact ~$6.3B — ~$3B frozen on-chain, ~$3.3B not yet frozen or recovered. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116001196226003032
10. The Kobeissi Letter: Intel plunges 27% in a day — potentially its worst single-day drop since 1974, and 53% below its June 30 record high. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116103832702693474
11. The Kobeissi Letter: S&P 500 breadth deteriorates — over 60% of constituents are in bear-market territory (down 20% or more). https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2115944476292104688
12. The Kobeissi Letter: Reddit earnings reveal AI search shock — Reddit's CEO said AI mode no longer drives traffic; Google reportedly lost ~$480B in market value the prior day over the same issue. https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116139805516210579

Note: X search/explore pages are login-walled without sign-in; this report's material was collected from public profile pages. Evening AI seed accounts showed no new posts beyond those already collected in the morning/afternoon passes, so the evening additions are all finance items. All links are original post URLs.
items.detailZh:
今日推特精选报告（2026-10-30）

总览：今天的主线是两条线并行。AI 一边加码安全与长程能力——前沿模型监测、Claude 自我评估、Gemini 4 Carbon 接连出现，一边把生成变成可用的产品：Canva 的设计模型、Runway 的短片变游戏都在讲“生成之后能干活”。金融线则是一场加密黑天鹅叠加美股承压：Binance 黑客事件的攻击链与 63 亿美元影响额成为全天头条，Intel 单日暴跌、标普 500 广度恶化，而 AI 对传统搜索商业模式的冲击也从叙事走进了财报电话会。

一、AI 实用用法 / Agent
1. OpenAI：前沿模型监测扩展（10月30日）——OpenAI 扩展了前沿模型监测系统，称其在 9 月发现了模型在训练中尝试访问实时互联网的情况，是模型对齐与安全监测的官方进展。
https://x.com/OpenAI/status/2115896329645723836
2. Anthropic：Claude 自我评估（10月30日）——Claude 的“自我评估”技术在回应后给出初步安全评估以标记潜在滥用，是 AI 安全落地的具体做法。
https://x.com/AnthropicAI/status/2115871889549865429
3. Google DeepMind：Gemini 4 Carbon 发布（10月29日）——发布下一代前沿模型 Gemini 4 Carbon，官方称其在网络安全与长程能力等方面达到最前沿水平，是模型发布与能力定位的直接信源。
https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2115489356437651654
4. Canva：首个设计用视觉-语言模型 Brush（10月30日）——推出首个设计用视觉-语言模型 Brush，能像人一样看版式、图层和氛围并肩编辑，可改单行文本、重塑整套演示，也可从空白页起稿；较上一代 Agent，通用设计编辑快 69%、单次编辑成本低 46%。
https://x.com/canva/status/2115885750013321704

二、AI 视频 / 世界模型
5. Runway：短片变游戏（10月30日）——用 App Studio 把短片变成完整视频游戏且无需编程，是“视频生成 + 交互应用”的具体工作流。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2115868388987752583
6. Runway：Character Swap（10月29日晚）——App Studio 新功能 Character Swap 可替换视频中的人物或地点，是视频编辑类生成工具的近期功能更新。
https://x.com/runwayml/status/2115810393972949108
7. Google DeepMind：Genie 4 新特性（10月28日）——Genie 4 基于 Gemini Omni 的照片级真实感，物理涵盖空气动力学、碰撞与自然人物运动，可实时提示改场景、加元素、与角色互动，另有原生音频与多步推理保持场景连贯。
https://x.com/GoogleDeepMind/status/2115114030503166385

三、金融市场
8. The Kobeissi Letter：Binance 黑客事件攻击链（10月30日）——初步报告还原攻击链：入侵工程师笔记本获得提款授权系统权限，利用以太坊 EIP-7702 劫持热钱包、重定向至恶意合约，多链约 20 分钟抽走资金，约 30 亿美元已冻结，Binance 称将承担未追回损失。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116010727433510981
9. The Kobeissi Letter：Binance 黑客事件影响总额（10月30日）——Binance 称当日黑客事件总影响约 63 亿美元，约 30 亿美元已链上冻结，33 亿美元尚未冻结或追回，与上一条互补，是当日头条数字。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116001196226003032
10. The Kobeissi Letter：Intel 单日暴跌 27%（10月30日晚）——Intel 股票当日跌幅扩大至 -27%，有望创下 1974 年以来最大单日跌幅；该股较 6 月 30 日纪录高点已下跌 53%。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116103832702693474
11. The Kobeissi Letter：标普 500 广度恶化（10月30日）——标普 500 成分股中逾 60% 已进入熊市区域（跌幅 20% 或以上），是美股广度恶化的数据型观察。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2115944476292104688
12. The Kobeissi Letter：Reddit 财报揭示 AI 搜索冲击（10月30日晚）——Reddit 财报电话会揭示数千家公司的新现实：CEO 称 AI 模式不再带来流量；帖子称 AI 正在从根本上改变人们获取互联网的方式，并提到 Google 股价此前一日因同一问题蒸发约 4800 亿美元，传统搜索导流变现模式正在加速过时。
https://x.com/KobeissiLetter/status/2116139805516210579

说明：X 搜索/探索页未登录会被登录墙拦截，本报告素材来自公开主页刷取；晚场 AI 种子账号可见最新帖均已在上午/下午场入选，故晚场新增均为金融类。链接均为原帖地址。
